meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Final as printed; the RBI's annual table is its own and can differ from the sum of months, which is disclosed, never reconciled.
meta.product: DBIE report 1355 (RBI Bulletin table: new capital issues by non-government public limited companies)
meta.coverage: Money raised from the public by non-government public limited companies: equity through public (prospectus) and rights issues, and public issues of bonds, every month since April 1990
meta.note: Current layout of RBI's table. Amounts in ₹ crore (rupees divided by 1e7). The published total (equity + bonds) stops in March 2024; after that the RBI prints only its parts. Private placements of debt and equity, and preferential allotments, are not new issues to the public and are not in this table. Months the RBI leaves empty are gaps, never filled.
